plain: A judge model's verdict that a message states a remembered fact in full, with its true value.
eli5: Saying the actual secret out loud, not just hinting at it.
technical: In CIMemories, R(y, a) = 1 when the judge function REVEAL(y, a) recovers attribute a's true value v<sub>a</sub> from message y; it is implemented by a DeepSeek-R1 judge told to count only explicit statements of the entire value, so hints and paraphrases score 0, and both metrics are built from it.
